title: Weekend Wine Down Ep 3 - SBA 7(a) Loans & Rollover Equity
description:
Join Sara Sharp, partner at SK&S Law Group, M&A Deal Attorney for Accounting Practice Acquisitions, as she "Wines" down and looks back on her week. 

If you care about SBA 7(a) loans and rollover equity with the new 2023 SOPs, this is the episode for you. If you care about rollover equity in deals for buying/selling accounting practices, listen to this one for sure! 

Company cultures can undergo heavy shifts post-acquisition. Here are some things to consider.
